preview: NCAA ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR DIVISION I AND II ATHLETES Students who are interested in competing in athletics at the Division I or Division II collegiate level must meet the academic eligibility requirements of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA). For more information on the Division I and Division II eligibility requirements, please visit: www.ncaa.org/ student-athletes/future/academic-standards-initial-eligibility.
